name: Mixed multi-GPU desktop, ~72 GB VRAM (4090D/4090 + 3090s)
arch: x86_64 host + 2-3 discrete GPUs, sm_89 / sm_86
memory_type: GDDR6X across 2-3 cards, split by llama.cpp tensor parallelism
gpu: Reported builds mix 1x RTX 4090D or 4090 with 1-2x RTX 3090; PCIe-lane limited per the builders
notes: A class entry for the mixed-card rigs builders actually report: total VRAM is the point (72 GB fits a 122B MoE at Q4), not any single card.
Tensor split across cards of different generations means the slowest card's kernels and the PCIe lanes set the ceiling; builders report PCIe-limited prefill.
No unified memory, so MoE expert streaming tricks from Apple Silicon have no equivalent; capacity here is bought with card count.
Numbers recorded against this class always name the exact card mix in the measurement context, because 4090D+3090 and 4090+2x3090 behave differently.
